title: Announced open-ended Oran taxi-driver strike
reason: Announced work stoppage; no public gathering verified
notes: The Dec. 8 roundup reports a planned open-ended strike beginning Dec. 16 over transport restrictions and support payments. Targeted follow-up did not verify a qualifying public gathering.

title: Planned M'sila teachers' work stoppage
reason: Announcement only; execution unverified; a strike alone is not a public gathering
notes: The Dec. 7 report announces a work stoppage alongside the second protest. The later roundup confirms a protest and march, but not the work stoppage.

title: Hassi Messaoud trainees' open-ended sit-in seeking employment
reason: Company-specific hiring dispute; own-state policy demand not established
notes: Reported ongoing outside the National Company for Oil Wells. Trainees sought jobs after qualification procedures; the report does not establish a government-policy demand. Onset is unknown; retained as a continuation lead.
